attribution.modificationNotice: Extracted the official complete-movie archive and transcoded the full film, including the ending credits, into AVC/H.264 HLS at 426x240 and 638x358 without upscaling. Re-encoded the embedded stereo soundtrack as AAC 48 kHz. HLS duration is 596.5 seconds. No captions, audio description, transcript or DRM were added. Credited JPEG posters and thumbnails were extracted separately.
